maria-marketing: Planning a small OSS onramp called Sparklet. Need: short tutorial, benchmark blurb, and a 30m demo webinar. Target: devs prototyping local inference. Thoughts?

devon-devrel: Yes. Tutorial = 3-step quickstart + example app. Short GIF + repo. I'll draft.

akash-eng: I can run microbenchmarks (laptop CPU quantized, small GPU, hosted baseline). Will supply p50/p95, tokens/sec, and notes on memory. Need final test script.

sam-growth: Webinar CTA -> landing page -> tutorial repo -> star. Recommend Thu 9am PT for EMEA reach. Email follow-ups: thank-you + benchmark PDF.

lily-design: I can make hero art and a 20s GIF showing CLI: `npx @redwood/sparklet init && npx @redwood/sparklet run --model small --quantize`. Confirm CLI and I'll export assets.

maria-marketing: Action items: devon = tutorial PR Tue EOD; akash = bench CSV + chart Wed AM; lily = hero + GIF Wed noon; sam = landing + email flow Wed EOD. ops-bot please create calendar + issue.

ops-bot: Created calendar event Sparklet Webinar Thu 09:00 PT. Created GitHub issue #sparklet-launch with assignees: @devon-devrel, @akash-eng, @lily-design, @sam-growth, @maria-marketing.

devon-devrel: I'll add a short benchmark paragraph (tweet blurb + blog paragraph) and link the raw CSV in the repo.

akash-eng: Note for blog: include methodology, quantization tradeoffs, and recommended VM specs to avoid OOMs. I'll add a 3-bullet pitfalls list.

maria-marketing: Great. We'll run a quick internal A/B test on hero copy tomorrow. Will post final micro-timeline here. Thanks! :tada:
